demo_script.name: Interactive Pipulate Demo
demo_script.description: An interactive demo that responds to keyboard input and branches based on user choices

steps.message: This is {app_name}, local first AI-readiness automation software. Would you like a demo? Press **Ctrl+Alt+y** or **Ctrl+Alt+n** on the keyboard.

ollama_messages.available: You hit yes. One thing about what you are about to hear: this tour is a fixed script, and the voice reading it is Piper, a speech synthesizer running on your machine. A local language model IS installed and will answer you in chat later, but it is not what narrates this. Turn the voice on? **Ctrl+Alt+y** / **Ctrl+Alt+n**
ollama_messages.not_available: You hit yes. This tour is a fixed script read aloud by Piper, a local speech synthesizer, so it runs with or without a language model. Ollama is not installed yet, so chat replies will be limited until it is. Turn the voice on? **Ctrl+Alt+y** / **Ctrl+Alt+n**

branch_no.message: Back to our regularly scheduled program.

tool_args.text: Welcome to the Great and Secret AI-Readiness Show. Everything in this tour is a scripted demonstration of the system, narrated by a local speech synthesizer. The chat box on the right is where a real model answers, and it will always name which model answered.

branch_dev_yes.description: 🎤 Chip O'Theseus speaks his first words
✨ Twinkling the chat input with gold magic

tool_args.text: Press control alt y to continue.

branch_dev_yes.message: For my first trick I will **Reset Entire DEV Database** to blank the sample demo data. Is that okay? **Ctrl+Alt+y** / **Ctrl+Alt+n**

ollama_messages.available: Thank you. I will be here to answer any of your questions when you need. And you can always restart the demo with Ctrl+Alt+D at any time.
ollama_messages.not_available: Thank you. You can always restart the demo with Ctrl+Alt+D at any time. Visit ollama.com for local LLM installation instructions.

branch_dev_reset_yes.message:
🎩 **Excellent!** The magic begins...

🗄️ **Database reset complete!**

✨ **Ready for the next trick!**

🎩 **That was the whole trick.**

Everything you just watched was a script: fixed text, a local speech synthesizer reading it aloud, and one real database reset.

💬 **The chat box on the right is the other half.** That one is a language model, and it names which model answered. Ask it anything.

branch_dev_reset_no.message:
🎩 **No worries!** The show must go on...

✨ **Perhaps another time for that trick!**

🌟 **Welcome to the future of local-first AI automation!**
